selectShapesAndLinesThat: Select shapes and lines that aren’t in a diagram
selectADiagramOrSomething: Select a diagram or something in one
selectADiagramWithA: Select a diagram with a layout (not manual)
selectStepsOfADiagram: Select steps of a diagram that were moved by hand
focusOnThisDiagramEsc: Focus on this diagram (Esc to leave)
layOutAgainStepsMoved: Lay out again (steps moved by hand too)
newItemsGoToThis: New items go to this layer (for you)
hideThisLayerForEveryone: Hide this layer for everyone (nothing is deleted)
lockThisLayerItsItems: Lock this layer: its items can’t be changed
deleteLayerItsItemsMove: Delete layer (its items move to the next layer)
selectADiagramOrSomething2: Select a diagram, or something in one, to see its layers.
topOfTheListIs: Top of the list is drawn on top. Hiding or locking a layer does it for everyone; the layer you pick is where your new items go.
